title: GPT-6 Astra proves a linear coloring bound for graphs excluding clique minors
summary: The authors present a proof of the Linear Hadwiger conjecture: there is a constant C such that every graph with no K_t minor is colorable with at most Ct colors. GPT-6 Astra developed the proof after the authors directed it to the dense case and then asked it to bridge existing bounds; the resulting proof combines several known frameworks with a new bootstrap argument. The result is an asymptotic linear bound, not the stronger Hadwiger conjecture χ(G)≤h(G).
ai_technology: OpenAI GPT-6 Astra (described in the paper as ChatGPT model Astra 6)
organization: University of British Columbia; University of Graz

evidence.tested: The authors present a proof of the Linear Hadwiger conjecture: there is a constant C such that every graph with no K_t minor is colorable with at most Ct colors.
evidence.unknown: The result is an arXiv preprint and is not the full Hadwiger conjecture. It proves existence of an absolute linear-coloring constant for K_t-minor-free graphs. The authors take responsibility for the proof; Independent formal verification was not assessed in the source review.
evidence.ai_role: Authors disclose that the proof was developed by the model following their research directions and feedback; the model supplied a new bootstrap argument after being prompted first on a dense case and then to bridge existing bounds. Authors independently wrote the exposition, reviewed the result and take responsibility for correctness.
